dogecoin.text: Damn! My #stocks are doing really good today! My #dogecoin is thru the roof! It will definitely hit $1 before the year is out. Hopefully, the people decide to hold well above that. Let's go for $10!

#Fact Had you invested your $1,200.00 stimulus check into #Dogecoin back in June or September, & sold it at its high of .74¢, you would have made over $350,000.00! To those who hate #capitalism, you may just suck at life.
#Stocks are on sale today. My portfolio is down a bit. What's up with #Dogecoin? People need to hold until it reaches a $1!
Cool! #Dogecoin is back on the rise! Will it reach $1 or more this time?
Hopefully, #Dogecoin hits a dollar before the summer ends. So my $28 investment from last year can turn into $9K!

Day 3 since my niece arrived. She spent over $40 ordering food when there's food in my apartment! "It's too healthy!" she said. Smh. She'd be a millionaire right now if she was smart w/ dem unemployment checks! She doesn't pay bills & coulda gone 'All-in' on #Dogecoin last year!

Now at part-time job until 11pm. What sh!t to tweet about? #Random Told my admirer about #Dogecoin when it was .08 cents. In hindsight, I shoulda bought 30K coins at that moment despite already having coins I held since 2021. Selling those 30K coins at .45 cents = $11.1K profit!

My friend, who is a crypto investor, once told me to sell all of my stocks & buy crypto. In hindsight, I shoulda listened to her. I'd 5x my entire portfolio on #Dogecoin alone. Moving forward, I'm investing 10% of my monthly dividend income on crypto plus a paycheck from my PTJ.
